title: cloud: service-ai pending-action approve/reject routes follow the AI-door confirmation rule (#33689 Q1 ruled B)
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mswnWm181XgYcCUag

Cloud lane card, per 「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡」 (Leehom, 2026-10-26T12:40Z). Follow-up of #33689. Q1 was ruled B on 2026-11-15T11:10:57Z (record on #33689).

## 维护者速读

1. **要做的**：云端 service-ai 的待批动作「同意 / 拒绝」接口改成新规则：只有本人、在登录状态下能同意，同意后按本人权限重查再执行。
2. **为什么**：应用内助手也适用 AI 入口确认规则（裁定 B）。
3. **范围**：只改云端这两个接口和它们的测试。应用内确认卡保留。
4. **需要你做的**：无。

## Change (cloud `service-ai`; this project cannot read cloud, so measure first)

`POST /api/v1/ai/pending-actions/:id/approve|reject` (today guarded by `ai:approve`):
- Only the person the call ran as may decide. An administrator approving someone else's AI proposal goes to the existing `held` outcome (the approvals engine) instead.
- Take a signed-in session only. Refuse an API key, token or AI identity, whoever it resolves to.
- An approved action runs as that person with every gate re-checked, and is not asked again.

Contract: the spec card #33808 (and the merged contract in `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`, PR #33725).
